rules: Engine is pure TypeScript: clock and RNG injected; no Math.random(), Date.now(), host timers or node:* imports under packages/engine/src (file I/O only in packages/engine/scripts).
No game logic in UI: screens talk only to GameHost (LocalGameHost for digit kinds, LocalFindHost for tap kinds); stars, end reasons, rules per kind and progress come from the engine.

New Rules keys are optional and ABSENT from the defaultRules literal (only overrides bring them in); never add them to GameRoomRuleOverrides or the server rulesSchema. Ranked/solo/bot behaviour, snapshots and stored rules stay byte-identical.
Levels run in engine modes 'solo' (no bot) and 'bot' with config.level set; no new GameMode.
tap is NOT a wire action: HostAction = ClientAction | TapAction; CLIENT_MESSAGE_TYPES, the server gate and PROTOCOL_VERSION (1) stay unchanged.

levels.json is a frozen data file built by script and committed; never regenerated at runtime; never statically imported from packages/engine/src/index.ts; loaded lazily on the phone. Bot search times of the tap kinds are frozen in it too (spec.bot.findMs), and a replay ('שוב', attempt >= 2) plays transformLevel(spec, attempt), an equivalent board, while LEVEL_RULES.replayTransform is on (D63).
Level games never write practice.db, never call PracticeSession/practiceFinished, never emit game_start/game_end, never queue a PracticeResult.
Level XP is derived by the server inside PUT /v1/me/levels from stored bests; the phone only shows an estimate.

Telemetry props use the key `level` (number), never `levelId`: our own GA4 privacy filter (PERSONAL_KEY in apps/mobile/src/services/ga4.ts) drops every key ending in 'id' (and keys containing name, user, device or install).
Compatibility: new app + old server (404 notFound on /v1/me/levels = 'unsupported', keep data; level telemetry batched separately) and old app + new server (additive only) must both work.

Every UI string through t() in he and en (namespace 'levels'; English says 'Stage', not 'Level'); every animation respects Reduced Motion; board and keypad always LTR; cell names like D5 wrapped with ltr(); signed numbers via signedText(); me = P1 colour + ●, bot = P2 + ▲.
Every engine rule gets a Jest test. A lane may edit only its ownedFiles, plus a sharedFiles entry it is listed for, and only after the owner lane is merged.

A rule that departs from the original spec (docs/00-original-spec-v1.md) is built per the original behind a switch until Moshe approves it (D62 reactions, D64 chain). A ☐ default is built as a setting that the code really reads, with a test that flips it.

Never name a source folder build/: the root .gitignore (line 29) and .prettierignore (line 4) ignore every folder named build at any depth. The level builder lives in packages/engine/src/levels/builder/.
No compile/APK, commit or deploy without Moshe's explicit OK.
